title: RFC-EG-0010 Lineage Document
description: A hash-chained lineage document as verified by src/verifier.js. Each event is chained twice, independently, under SHA3-512 and BLAKE2b-512. This schema encodes exactly what the reference verifier enforces and adds no constraint it does not check.

rfc.description: Specification identifier this document conforms to.

operation_id.description: Identifier of the operation this lineage describes. Every event carries the same value in op_id.

events.description: Events in strict sequence order. seq starts at 1 and increments by exactly 1; the verifier rejects any gap or repeat.

evt.description: Event type in dotted form. The reference set is not closed; a verifier must chain unknown types rather than reject them.

op_id.description: Operation this event belongs to. Matches the document's operation_id.

seq.description: Position in the chain. The first event is 1; each subsequent event is exactly one greater than its predecessor.

producer.description: The component that emitted the event.

instance.description: Instance identifier, conventionally a governance:// URI.

payload.description: Event-specific body. Shape varies by evt and is deliberately open. Every byte of it is covered by chash and chash_b.

prev_hash.description: chash of the preceding event, or null on the first event.

prev_hash_b.description: chash_b of the preceding event, or null on the first event.

chash.description: SHA3-512 over the canonical event body concatenated with prev_hash, or with the literal string "genesis" on the first event. The body is the event with chash, chash_b and sig removed, serialised with keys sorted recursively.

chash_b.description: BLAKE2b-512 over the same canonical body concatenated with prev_hash_b, or with "genesis" on the first event. Computed independently of chash, so a break in one chain does not hide a break in the other.

sig.description: Optional detached signature over the event. Excluded from the canonical body before hashing, so adding or removing it does not alter chash or chash_b.
